basic_info.description: Charming and thoughtfully updated, this 2-bed, 1.5-bath home blends classic character with modern comforts. As you step into this newly renovated home you'll notice a spacious living room with double-pane windows and a fireplace which flows into a formal dining roomideal for entertaining. The newly remodeled kitchen features a skylight, new flooring, quality cabinets, sleek countertops, and brand-new appliances. A stylish half bath sits off the hallway, while the updated full bath with a skylight connects to one of the two large rear bedrooms, both with oversized double-pane windows for comfort and light. Fresh paint inside and out, refinished hardwood floors, new light fixtures, and a new furnace add to the updates. On the lower level, a massive garage offers interior access, high-end washer/dryer, abundant storage, and possible ADU potential. From the garage, step out to the oversized terraced backyard, perfect for gardening. Located near UCSF, Golden Gate Park, community gardens, and a short stroll to the vibrant 9th & Irving corridor where you'll enjoy renowned eateries, cafes, unique shops, and easy public transit. Centrally located with quick access to the North and South Bay, this home combines timeless charm, modern upgrades, and ideal city living.
